goal: The feed will shift to about 69 wt % ethylene and the unit needs about 25 % more ethylene from this tower at polymer-grade purity. Find what limits the tower, propose the change, and make the design pass every engineering check, including the documented product purity spec (ethane in the ethylene product at most 0.1 wt %) and the +10 % feed operating envelope.

Tray maker guaranteed capacity and efficiency for the replacement trays: The design uses capacity factor 1.85 and efficiency 0.88 (run PV1767-round2-115-b405-v38). If the maker guarantees less than 1.85 or less than 0.88, the overload and purity results must be re-solved and the +25% and +10% conclusions may fail.

Actual future feed ethylene content: The check uses about 69 wt% ethylene (mole fraction 0.7051 in run PV1767-round2-115-b405-v38). If the real feed is leaner, 115,000 kg/h may not yield 25% more ethylene and a higher feed rate or different settings would be needed.

Cooling and heating supply capability for PV-1767: The model needs 35,611 kW of condensing and 26,066 kW of reboiling at 115,000 kg/h (run PV1767-round2-115-b405-v38) and no utility limit is in the model. If either system cannot supply this, the tower cannot hold the proposed reflux and boil-up, and the rate and purity conclusions fail.
